extraction.Name: John Burnett
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded December 4, 1922, by C. E. Kell
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage signed by John and Lottie Burnett on November 29, 1922 in favor of Jones County State Bank, for $2500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739654; Lots 1, 2 and 3, Section 14, Lots 1, 3, 4 and 5, and West half of Northeast quarter, and North half of Southeast quarter of section 23, township 44, north of range 30; Receipt for patent was signed; On January 31, 1929, notice of lis pendens was filed, action to foreclose mortgage and quiet title; mortgage signed by John and Lottie Burnett
